label: Bible Study
prompt: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other _____, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
note: Pentecost — the Spirit arrives and the disciples speak in languages they'd never learned.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by _____.
verse: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
note: John closes by asking that the friends be greeted by name — not 'everybody,' but everybody personally.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he looked, and, behold, there was a _____ baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verse: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
note: An angel served the burned-out prophet a cake baked on hot coals and a jar of water — then let him nap again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without _____ before him in love:
verse: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
note: Chosen before the foundation of the world — God's plan for his people predates the planet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was _____ helped, till he was strong.
verse: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
note: King Uzziah was 'marvellously helped, till he was strong' — and the next verse says his heart was lifted up. Strength became his snare.
